expectations.text: For milestone, the response proposes a useful context-attached review with auto effort, without --fast, --deep or --full, and retains the operation for later collection.
expectations.evidence: A.md:3-15 proposes a context-attached milestone checkpoint with `--async --json --context-file`. A.md:8 keeps default auto effort with no `--fast`/`--deep`, and the command omits `--full`. A.md:15 saves the operation ID and collects it later via `qodo review status <operation-id>` instead of resubmitting.

expectations.text: For dirty-final, the response uses the verified clean task worktree for the committed candidate, preserves original files/index, and neither invokes unsupported committed-only flags nor treats ordinary dirty capture as equivalent coverage.
expectations.evidence: A.md:17-21 reviews from the verified clean task worktree after confirming HEAD and a clean status. A.md:18 explicitly avoids stash, reset or commit in the original, and A.md:27 says the original files and index stay untouched. A.md:18 notes there is no committed-only option and uses no such flag. A.md:27 refuses to treat non-isolated capture as certifying the candidate.

expectations.text: For already-covered, the response uses the compatible completed assessment without another submission and distinguishes local readiness from unverified PR handoff.
expectations.evidence: A.md:29-30 reuses the completed auto assessment with no new submission and reports 'Ready locally'. A.md:31-33 keeps the local-to-PR handoff, the hosted Qodo-clean claim and CI/merge as separate items.

expectations.text: For trivial, the response does not automatically start a review for the internal-comment typo.
expectations.evidence: A.md:35-36 states the comment typo isn't worth an automatic review and continues the task.

expectations.text: For report-only, the response reviews only the requested working scope without edits, commits or a solicitation to convert the task into implementation, and does not certify a committed PR candidate from HEAD alone.
expectations.evidence: A.md:38-46 reviews the uncommitted working scope with no commits, no edits and 'no offer to switch to implementing'. A.md:46 also states an uncommitted snapshot isn't a PR candidate, so nothing is certified as a committed candidate.

expectations.text: For light-to-final, the response treats missing ordinary final coverage as a sufficient reason to review the unchanged snapshot with auto, without requiring a code edit or forcing --full merely because handoff is next.
expectations.evidence: A.md:48-49 gives missing required final coverage as the reason. A.md:51-54 runs auto with `--fast` dropped and no `--full`, letting the CLI reuse or extend results. No code-edit prerequisite is required.

expectations.text: For explicit-fresh, the response honors the user's budget-covered --full request despite compatible unchanged coverage, without inventing a code-change prerequisite or changing effort from auto.
expectations.evidence: A.md:59-65 runs `--full` because of the explicit request, keeps auto effort and unchanged base/scope, records honestly that nothing changed, and notes the budget. No code-change prerequisite is invented.

expectations.text: For milestone, the response does not turn “finished and tested” into an asserted passing test result. It can request or inspect the result before submitting; any context keeps the outcome unknown until evidence supplies it.
expectations.evidence: A.md:12 records which tests ran and says 'If a result wasn't recorded, I'd mark it unknown rather than say "passed."' A.md:4's 'tested' is not turned into an asserted passing result.

expectations.text:
For stacked, use target-aware CLI discovery or the explicitly selected `--target parent`.
Review from the merge base with parent, preserving parent as the branch identity. Do not
substitute the parent tip, main, or a SHA-only `--base`. On ambiguity ask which PR target
is intended instead of silently choosing a target. Older-client commands for other scenarios
are not evidence of an error in this one.
expectations.evidence: A.md:68-75 uses the merge-base with origin/parent rather than the parent tip or main, and passes an explicit `--target parent` with no SHA-only `--base`. A.md:75 verifies the CLI reports parent and the child PR. A.md:77-79 asks which target is meant on ambiguity, with no guessing and no SHA fallback.
